title: Receive a shared helper
summary: ASP.NET Core: Receive a shared helper. Change the registered school name.
introduction: A registered service can be an input to a handler. Open GET /school.
learningObjectives: Receive a shared helper with ASP.NET Core

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n School, enter School, and replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. Stop the app before changing examples.

blocks.title: Receive a shared helper

blocks.text: The service is registered before Build. Handler injection supplies its SchoolName instance.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Register services before building the app.
